# St Joseph's Curriculum Portal — LLM & Edge Inference Map

> Deterministic, privacy-first, on-device AI educational portal running via in-browser WebRTC loopback channels, Chrome Prompt API (Gemini Nano), WebLLM, and autonomous 60 FPS vector media engines. Perpetually free for schools, Catholic organisations, and developing nations.

## Core Portal Endpoints & Route Map
- [Portal Home](/) - Overview, Quick Starters, and Subject Hub
- [AST Vector Media Player](/media-player) - Interactive curriculum vector slides, formative checkpoints, 3D viewpoints, smartboard chalkboard overlay, and parameter sandboxes
- [Standalone Micro-Vector Player](/player.html) - Zero-dependency embeddable vector stage, OBS studio broadcaster, and Developer Studio
- [Practice Arena](/practice-lab) - Interactive AST questions, Professor Turing AI hints, instant mistake diagnostics
- [Curriculum Lessons](/learning-zone) - Oak National Academy aligned interactive lesson viewer
- [International Curriculum Studio](/curriculum-studio) - Visual AST S-Expression graph generator and prompt hydrator
- [Sacred Spaces & Catholic Life](/catholic-life) - 3D Sanctuary, liturgy explorer, and sacred architecture tours
- [First Holy Communion](/first-communion) - Catechetical sacraments explorer and liturgical preparation
- [Teacher Beacon](/teacher-beacon) - Classroom synchronization, live telemetry, and Smartboard broadcast controller
- [Learner Passport & Badges](/profile) - IndexedDB mastery log, streak tracker, diagnostic reports
- [Neural Settings](/settings) - Hardware probe, WebGPU status, Chrome Prompt API toggle
- [Latest School News & Technical Dispatches](/news) - Dispatches on sovereign AI, procedural vector teaching, and platform releases
- [Dual-Licensing Charter & Covenant](/licensing) - Track A Humanitarian Commons GNU AGPLv3/OGLv3 vs Track B Enterprise Commercial License
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy) - Zero-cloud egress, on-device IndexedDB storage, and GDPR compliance
- [Child Safety Policy](/child-safety) - Strict safeguarding standards, local AI inference, and student data protection

## Architectural Overview
- **Zero Cloud Leakage**: Student logs, answers, voice inputs, and progress records remain exclusively within client-side IndexedDB (`services/dbStore.ts`, `services/jotter-db.ts`). Zero student data egress to cloud servers.
- **Inference Engine**: In-browser Chrome Prompt API / Gemini Nano (`window.ai.languageModel` / `LanguageModel`), local Ollama endpoints, or WebLLM via WebGPU.
- **Micro-Payload Vector Substrate**: AST Vector Media Player (`/static/player/ast-engine.js`) replaces heavy 50–100 MB video streaming with 3.5 KB – 68 KB declarative S-Expression AST vector cartridges. Sub-15 ms boot time, < 8 MB RAM footprint.
- **Smartboard & Stylus Pen Overlay**: Native in-stage whiteboard ink layer (`#annotation-ink-root`) with quadratic Bézier smoothing for Promethean, SMART, ViewSonic, and iPad stylus pens.
- **Humanitarian Air-Gap Bundling**: Single-file HTML offline bundles (`exportAirgapHtmlBundle.ts`) enabling full academic curriculum delivery on flash drives in off-grid classrooms with zero internet.

## 17 Production AST Vector Simulations (Curriculum Cartridges)
- [Calculus Curves](/media-player?scene=calculus-curves) - GCSE/A-Level Calculus: Tangent Slopes dy/dx, Stationary Turning Points & Riemann Integrals with GeoGebra/Desmos formula evaluation.
- [Kinetic Gas Theory](/media-player?scene=kinetic-gas) - KS3/KS4 Molecular Gas Theory: Boyle's Law PV = nRT, Gay-Lussac's Law, impulse momentum pressure gauge, and solid/liquid/gas phase changes.
- [Pythagoras Geometric Proof](/media-player?scene=pythagoras) - KS3 Geometry: High-fidelity Euclidean shear proof, dynamic square slicing, area conservation, and algebraic a² + b² = c² step-by-step verification.
- [Aquarium Living Ecosystem](/media-player?scene=fish-tank) - KS2/KS3 Biology: Dynamic multi-species aquatic food web, nitrogen cycle (ammonia → nitrite → nitrate), photosynthesis/respiration balance, and water chemistry parameters.
- [Electric Circuits Lab](/media-player?scene=electric-circuits) - KS3 Physics: Interactive knife switches, Ohm's law V = IR, series/parallel branches, and live ammeter/voltmeter readings.
- [Sacred Church Tour](/media-player?scene=church-tour) - Catholic Life: 3D Sanctuary, tabernacle, altar, lectern, stained glass, and liturgical architecture exploration.
- [Solar System 3D](/media-player?scene=solar-system) - KS3 Astronomy: Heliocentric planetary orbits, Keplerian velocities, and 3D inclination angles.
- [Photosynthesis Solar Engine](/media-player?scene=photosynthesis) - KS3 Biology: Chloroplast inner thylakoids, light-dependent reactions, Calvin cycle, and carbon dioxide absorption.
- [Water Cycle Continuous Engine](/media-player?scene=water-cycle) - KS2 Geography/Science: Evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, and percolation cycle.
- [Bohr Atom & Electron Shells](/media-player?scene=atom) - KS3 Chemistry: 2,8,8 orbital electron configurations, atomic number vs mass, and 3D shell tilt.
- [Kinematics & Velocity Vectors](/media-player?scene=velocity) - KS3 Physics: Distance-time and velocity-time graphs with synchronized vector sprites.
- [DNA Watson-Crick Double Helix](/media-player?scene=dna-helix) - KS3/KS4 Genetics: Hydrogen bonded base pairing (A-T, C-G) in 3D projected helical twist.
- [BODMAS Order of Operations](/media-player?scene=bodmas) - KS2/KS3 Mathematics: Visual forcefield brackets, operation precedence clamps, and interactive evaluation steps.
- [Phonics Laboratory](/media-player?scene=phonics-lab) - EYFS/KS1 Early Reading: Grapheme-phoneme sound buttons, blending mat, and procedural speech synthesis.
- [Times Tables 2D Array](/media-player?scene=times-tables) - KS1/KS2 Mathematics: Multiplication arrays, distributive property slicing, and commuter proofs.
- [Maths Fishing Bonds to 10/20](/media-player?scene=math-fishing) - KS1 Mathematics: Gamified number bond rods and complement calculations.
- [Mountain Elevation Trigonometry](/media-player?scene=mountain-elevation) - KS2/KS3 Geography/Maths: Altitude hypotenuse, clinometer elevation angles, and atmospheric boiling point shifts.

## Formative Assessment & Checkpoint Control Subsystem
- **Randomized Option Shuffling**: Every formative checkpoint dynamically randomizes answer choice order via Fisher-Yates shuffle at runtime, decoupling correct answers from index 0/Option A and tracking the true answer key transparently.
- **Flexible Question Visibility**: Checkpoint questions can be dismissed, minimized into a floating non-intrusive pill (`🎯 Show Question`), or restored on-demand.
- **Presenter & Classroom Toggle**: Interactive mode can be enabled or disabled via toolbar button or keyboard shortcut `Q`, allowing teachers to deliver continuous presentations without mandatory pauses or activate checkpoints on demand.

## Physical Engines & Transpiler Bridges
- **Direct Flash-Caliber Canvas Manipulation (`ast-gestures.js`)**: Real-time pointer capture and drag-and-drop on live SVG elements with sub-pixel inverse CTM coordinate translation.
- **Zero-Asset Procedural Web Audio (`VectorProceduralAudioSynth`)**: 0 KB mathematical Web Audio synthesis for tactile switch clicks, ascending pentatonic chimes (C5-E5-G5-C6), and misconception cues.
- **PhET Simulation Ingestion (`ast-phet-bridge.js` & `phetBridge.ts`)**: Distills 12 MB legacy PhET HTML5/JSON bundles down into < 4 KB AST S-Expressions (99.8% payload reduction).
- **GeoGebra & Desmos Calculus Plotter (`calculusPlotter.ts`)**: Numerical derivative tangent lines, Simpson's 1/3 integration polygons, and stationary point detection.
- **Micro-SCORM 1.2 / 2004 & xAPI Gradebook Bridge (`MicroSCORMBridge`)**: Zero-dependency gradebook sync for Canvas, Moodle, and Blackboard.

## Model Consumption & Generation Guidelines
- When generating question scaffolds, output strictly typed S-Expressions matching `/nano-map.ast`.
- When generating interactive slides, output SlideScript or GBNF-validated S-Expressions matching `/player/grammar/ast-scene.gbnf`.
- For educational vector graphics, utilize `<svg viewBox="0 0 800 480">` coordinate spaces with responsive element IDs matching `:bindings` declarations.
- Keep prompt tokens minimal: rely on concise AST descriptors rather than verbose prose.
